_note: Effect sizes are game assumptions (ILLUSTRATIVE), not NASA figures; say so in the UI. Each effect multiplies an assumption read by js/sim/simulate.js.

events.name: Solar storm
events.headline: SOLAR STORM DETECTED
events.detail: Increased solar activity is affecting spacecraft power and operating conditions.
events.response: Add array margin, or switch off an instrument to cut the load.

events.name: Battery ages faster than rated
events.headline: BATTERY DEGRADATION DETECTED
events.detail: Battery capacity is declining faster than expected.
events.response: Choose a larger battery, or a shorter-eclipse orbit.

events.name: Intermittent communication link
events.headline: COMMS LINK DEGRADED
events.detail: The spacecraft is experiencing intermittent communication with the ground.
events.response: Pick an orbit with more contact time, or a higher data-rate transponder.

events.name: Instrument draws more power than expected
events.headline: INSTRUMENT POWER SPIKE
events.detail: A science instrument is consuming more power than expected.
events.response: Drop the most power-hungry instrument or add battery and array.

events.name: Orbit entry needs extra delta-v
events.headline: ADDITIONAL MANEUVER REQUIRED
events.detail: Orbit insertion requires more delta-v than originally expected.
events.response: Carry more propellant, or choose an orbit that is cheaper to enter.
